# Elevated errors on GPT-5.4 Nano

## What Changed

Nov 2, 18:24 UTC Resolved - On November 2, 2026, between 17:30 and 18:10 UTC, background tasks such as generating commit messages in GitHub Copilot were degraded. This was due to elevated errors with GPT-5.4 nano, a utility model. The elevated errors originated from an issue with an upstream model provider. No models that users could pick in the model picker were impacted. Service recovered when the upstream provider released a fix. We are working with the provider to understand the root cause and prevent similar issues from occurring going forward. Nov 2, 18:10 UTC Monitoring - The degradation affecting Copilot AI Model Providers has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability. Nov 2, 17:58 UTC Update - We are experiencing degraded availability for the GPT-5.4 Nano model in Copilot products and IDE surfaces. This is due to an issue with an upstream model provider. Nov 2, 17:46 UTC Update - We are investigating reports of elevated errors on GPT-5.4 Nano Nov 2, 17:46 UTC Investigating - We are investigating reports of degraded performance for Copilot AI Model Providers

## Why It Matters to a CSA

Service degradation can affect delivery confidence and operational readiness.
